```{=html}
<style>
  .split-scan .scan-plot svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; }
</style>
<div class="split-scan" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.45fr) minmax(0,1fr);align-items:center;gap:1em">
  <div class="scan-plot" role="img"
       aria-label="The same partition of 20 samples. A vertical rule crosses the left x-band. Green rings mark crossed samples. A red center also marks membership in the upper-left leaf.">
{{< include figures/split.svg >}}
  </div>
  <div>
    <p class="scan-threshold-value" style="font-size:.78em;font-weight:600" aria-hidden="true"></p>
    <table aria-label="Sample counts for the candidate split" aria-live="polite"
           style="width:100%;font-size:.76em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums">
      <thead><tr><th scope="col">Count</th><th scope="col">Left</th><th scope="col">Right</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>
        <tr><th scope="row" style="color:#176c3c"><i>n</i><sub>X</sub></th><td>0</td><td>12</td></tr>
        <tr><th scope="row" style="color:#bc303d"><i>n</i><sub>XY</sub></th><td>0</td><td>9</td></tr>
      </tbody>
    </table>
    <p style="font-size:.69em">Green rings mark the samples counted in <i>n</i><sub>X</sub> on the left.
       Red centers mark the ones also counted in <i>n</i><sub>XY</sub>.</p>
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8em;font-size:.68em">
      <button type="button" style="font:inherit;min-width:4.4em">Play</button>
      <label>Candidate <input type="range" min="0" step="1" value="0" style="width:5.1em;accent-color:#006d68"></label>
      <span class="scan-position" aria-hidden="true"></span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(() => {
  const demo = document.currentScript.previousElementSibling;
  const plot = demo.querySelector('.scan-plot svg');
  const bounds = plot.querySelector('clipPath rect');
  const [plotLeft, plotTop, plotWidth, plotHeight] = ['x', 'y', 'width', 'height']
    .map(name => Number(bounds.getAttribute(name)));
  const bandEnd = plotLeft + plotWidth / 2;
  const outcomeEdge = plotTop + plotHeight / 4;
  const samples = Array.from(plot.querySelectorAll('#PathCollection_1 use'), dot => ({
    x: Number(dot.getAttribute('x')),
    y: Number(dot.getAttribute('y'))
  })).filter(({x}) => x <= bandEnd).sort((a, b) => a.x - b.x);
  const lists = [samples, samples.filter(({y}) => y < outcomeEdge)];

  const overlay = plot.appendChild(document.createElementNS(plot.namespaceURI, 'g'));
  overlay.innerHTML = `
    ${samples.map(({x, y}) => `
      <g class="scan-highlight">
        <circle class="scan-ring" cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="5.3" fill="#fbfaf6" stroke="#176c3c" stroke-width="1.4"/>
        <circle class="scan-center" cx="${x}" cy="${y}" r="3.3" fill="${y < outcomeEdge ? '#bc303d' : '#176c3c'}"/>
      </g>`).join('')}
    <path class="scan-threshold" visibility="hidden" d="M0 ${plotTop}v${plotHeight}"
          stroke="#213b40" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/>`;

  const cut = overlay.querySelector('.scan-threshold');
  const highlights = overlay.querySelectorAll('.scan-highlight');
  const reducedMotion = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  const button = demo.querySelector('button');
  const slider = demo.querySelector('input');
  const readout = demo.querySelector('.scan-position');
  const thresholdValue = demo.querySelector('.scan-threshold-value');
  const tableRows = demo.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');

  const steps = [{cutX: plotLeft, left: [0, 0]}];
  const left = [0, 0];
  const xValues = [...new Set(samples.map(({x}) => x))];
  for (let i = 1; i < xValues.length; i++) {
    const cutX = (xValues[i - 1] + xValues[i]) / 2;
    lists.forEach((list, index) => {
      while (left[index] < list.length && list[left[index]].x <= cutX) left[index]++;
    });
    steps.push({cutX, left: [...left]});
  }

  const last = steps.length - 1;
  slider.max = last;
  let step = 0;
  let timer;
  let frame;
  let visibleX = plotLeft;

  function paintCut(x) {
    visibleX = x;
    cut.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${x} 0)`);
    highlights.forEach((mark, i) => {
      mark.setAttribute('visibility', samples[i].x <= x ? 'visible' : 'hidden');
    });
  }

  function moveCut(targetX, animate) {
    cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
    if (!animate || reducedMotion.matches) return paintCut(targetX);
    const originX = visibleX;
    const start = performance.now();
    function tick(now) {
      const progress = Math.min((now - start) / 280, 1);
      paintCut(originX + progress * (targetX - originX));
      if (progress < 1) frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    }
    frame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  function draw(index, animate = false) {
    step = index;
    const {cutX, left} = steps[index];
    const threshold = Number(((cutX - plotLeft) / plotWidth).toFixed(3));
    moveCut(cutX, animate);
    cut.setAttribute('visibility', index ? 'visible' : 'hidden');
    thresholdValue.textContent = index ? `x = ${threshold}` : 'Before the first candidate';
    left.forEach((count, row) => {
      const {cells} = tableRows[row];
      cells[1].textContent = count;
      cells[2].textContent = lists[row].length - count;
    });
    slider.value = index;
    slider.setAttribute('aria-valuetext', index ? `Candidate ${index} of ${last}, threshold ${threshold}` : 'Before the first candidate');
    readout.textContent = `${index} / ${last}`;
  }

  function pause() {
    clearInterval(timer);
    timer = undefined;
    button.textContent = step === last ? 'Replay' : 'Play';
  }

  function advance() {
    draw(step + 1, true);
    if (step === last) pause();
  }

  button.onclick = () => {
    if (timer) return pause();
    if (step === last) draw(0);
    button.textContent = 'Pause';
    timer = setInterval(advance, 1150);
    advance();
  };
  slider.oninput = () => { draw(Number(slider.value)); pause(); };
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => Reveal.on('slidechanged', pause));
  draw(0);
})();
</script>
```
